method: Every negative audited against JPML records (pending and terminated MDL reports, hearing orders) through 2026-09-01.

exclusions.subject: Sorin 3T Heater-Cooler System
exclusions.reason: Denied on the first petition (cutoff 2017-01-26) but granted as MDL 2816 on 2018-02-01, about twelve months after the cutoff and inside the 18-month horizon; the benchmark separately carries the granted No. II petition (lews-0032), so relabeling would double-count one MDL. Excluded in v1.1.

exclusions.subject: omeprazole
exclusions.reason: At its 2024-06-01 cutoff the substance sat under the active ~11,400-case proton-pump-inhibitor MDL 2789 (D.N.J., created 2017) and New Jersey MCL 631; not a negative under any reading. Excluded in v1.1.

criterion_note: The never-consolidated criterion reads: no active MDL at cutoff and no consolidation within the horizon. Five v1 negatives (atorvastatin, sertraline, gabapentin, albuterol, bisphenol) have pre-2015 MDL histories; their horizon labels are correct and they remain included.
right_censored_note: Cutoffs from 2025-03 onward cannot yet have complete 18-month outcome windows; labels reflect JPML outcomes observed through 2026-09-01.
effect: Excluding both rows (n=165) raises every trained model by about +0.005 AUROC and deepens the below-chance petitions-only logistic result. Reference predictions reproduce both versions.
